description.value:
Frequency once per encounter for each trigger

Trigger An effect would disarm you, or would render you unconscious without reducing you to 0 Hit Points.

You can't be disarmed or knocked unconscious by a single effect anymore — it always takes two.

The first time each encounter that an effect would disarm you, it fails and you are instead off-guard until the end of your next turn. The first time each encounter that an effect would render you unconscious without reducing you to 0 Hit Points, it fails and you are instead stunned 1. Effects that reduce you to 0 Hit Points are unaffected by this feat.

cinderfall.incomplete: First disarm attempt each encounter fails, the caster is off-guard instead; the first would-be-unconscious-without-0-HP effect each encounter fails, the caster is stunned 1 instead. No rule element applies a substituted, guaranteed self-condition in place of another effect's resolution, and no rule element negates another effect's resolution outright (an effect that "would" disarm/incapacitate but "fails" is the same class of gap as AdjustDegreeOfSuccess's own confirmed inability to manufacture a success from nothing).
